hpmicrosimr 0.1.8
  • Reference

    calABM2

    calABM2.Rd

    macro-calibration of hpmicrosimr using mclapply for linux systems

    calABM2(
  sD,
  Nrun = 4,
  n_unused_cores = 2,
  use_parallel = T,
  beta,
  lambda,
  p,
  nu,
  rho,
  delta
)

    Arguments

    sD

    base scenario (historical)

    Nrun

    number of runs

    n_unused_cores

    unsued cores default 2

    use_parallel

    TRUE or FALSE

    beta

    financial utility scale (drawn from financial_utility_scale)

    lambda

    bias correction parameter

    p

    rate parameter default 0.085

    nu

    usable roof fraction for solar

    rho

    rho_solstice parameter

    delta

    finance_rate calibration parameter

    Details

    return uptake (number of households and installed capacity) in june 2023 and 2024 for comparison with ISEA reports
